verdict.rationale: Aircall is a cloud phone system, so searching for and buying local numbers by area code is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents searching available numbers, filtering by area code, or purchasing a local number, whether in the UI or through the API. The cited items cover OAuth, webhooks, calls, SMS, campaigns, AI features and partner trial accounts, none of which address number provisioning.

support.subject: As a founder, I can search available numbers by area code and buy a local number in minutes
